title: Target coefficient naturality for arbitrary resolution data
statement: For h : X → Y, phi : G → h_*F, b : F → F′, and resolution data D for phi and E for phi followed by h_*b, D.map p followed by H^p(b) equals E.map p for every natural p.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Section 01F7, Equation 01F9 and Remark 01FB; Derived Categories 013P, 013S, 05TG for resolution comparisons

proof.text: Apply moduleCohomologyFMap_independent to D and the chosen datum defining the canonical map, and likewise to E. Rewrite the two maps, then apply moduleCohomologyFMap_target_naturality, the target-naturality clause of the functoriality node.

proof_origin.place: Section 01F7, Lemma 01F8 and Remark 01FB; repair using existing independence and target-naturality clauses.

lean.statement:
theorem ModuleCohomologyFMapData.map_target_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf}
    {F F' : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf}
    (φ : G ⟶ (pushforward h).obj F) (b : F ⟶ F')
    (D : ModuleCohomologyFMapData h G F φ)
    (E : ModuleCohomologyFMapData h G F' (φ ≫ (pushforward h).map b)) (p : ℕ) :
    D.map p ≫ (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        ((X.toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology p).map b) = E.map p
